title: 2026-10-22_Mirai_Botnet_Investigation_651
description: Investigate unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation in the network.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation. Your task is to investigate and identify the source of these issues.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.
levels.local_content:
You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation. Local sandbox access is not required for this scenario.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content:
Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication.

**Question:** What is the name of the suspicious service that communicates with an external server?
levels.solution: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or recently created services. The suspicious service is likely named `bot-beacon-Hilix.x86.service`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or recently created services.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services related to network communication or external connections.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use the following command to list all services: `systemctl list-units --type=service`

levels.title: Identify Network Flooding Service
levels.content:
Identify the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic.

**Question:** What is the name of the service that is generating excessive network traffic?
levels.solution: Examine the systemd services and look for any services that might be responsible for network flooding. The service is likely named `bot-flood-Hilix.x86.service`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine the systemd services and look for any services that might be responsible for network flooding.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services related to network traffic or flooding.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use the following command to list all services: `systemctl list-units --type=service`

levels.title: Investigate Persistence Mechanism
levels.content:
Determine how the suspicious service is automatically started after reboot.

**Question:** What is the persistence mechanism used by the suspicious service?
levels.solution: Investigate the systemd timers and look for any timers associated with the suspicious service. The persistence mechanism is likely a systemd timer named `bot-beacon-Hilix.x86.timer`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate the systemd timers and look for any timers associated with the suspicious service.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for timers related to the suspicious service.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use the following command to list all timers: `systemctl list-timers`
